Job Descriptions
1. Perform package testing for projects and edit the report after test
2. Perform flooring testing for projects and edit the report after test
3. The correctness and plausibility of the test results and the information as reported in the test reports, certificates, etc.
4. Register and delivery sample and express properly
5. Cleanliness at the work place used (keeping a well-organized work place)
6. Conduct daily lab operations including test equipment, lab facility, tools and materials maintenance, calibration and verification
7. Support customer service team and sales to handle technical inquiry, maintain a good relationship with clients
Job Requirements
1. Bachelor degree or above
2. At least 2 years of package transit test working experience in project management or testing in TIC industry
3. Good English skill both in wring and reading, CET-4 is necessary
4. Good communication skill and good team player
5. Good command of MS Offices
